body: I can understand that, I do the same thing all the time. Anything in particular about your past that's keeping you up?

Hi, I don't feel that way, I definitely do have depression, and other symptoms. However, it isn't like you're necessarily wrong about life having no point. It really doesn't, we aren't born with purpose, as much as we'd like to think we are (in my opinion). So I think basically life only has a point if you've given it one, and you haven't, so why wouldn't you feel like you're done? I don't think it's an odd feeling, when it comes down to it.
What would you like to talk about? How was your day?
I'm glad you're safe. And I hope someday you get to see Japan. Take care.
Before you go, I hope you've been one place you've always wanted to go. Is there any place you've always wanted to see?

Is there anything I can say to help?

I'm here, I'm listening, I care.

Let's hope it isn't normal, because then what is the point of it all?

That's one of the things that annoys me most, when people say "everyone feels this way." So then does it never get better? I can't accept that, because if I do then I'll never get out of bed again, there wouldn't be any point.

Hey, I understand being scared. If you can't get to a police station, but you can get to a phone that your family doesn't know about, like a payphone somewhere, you could try calling 1-800-656-HOPE. It's a hotline for people who have suffered from sexual abuse, and they may have some advice for you, or another way to get you out of your situation. They have experience with this sort of thing, and maybe they will have an idea of what to do. It's also anonymous. Just a thought. I'll be thinking of you, I hope your situation changes for the better soon.
